Cottage Bouquet

A charming scatter of delicate blooms in soft pastels—blush pink, periwinkle blue, cream, and soft yellow—creates an effortlessly romantic garden feel. Each cluster of flowers and green leaves is hand-painted with watercolor softness, evoking the unhurried beauty of a countryside cottage garden in perpetual bloom.
